fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rangriti – Hand-Painted Rajasthani Wooden Serving Tray
fields.DESCRIPTION: Brighten up your dining or décor space with Rangriti – a handcrafted Rajasthani wooden tray that brings together tradition, art, and functionality. Decorated in a vivid patchwork-style design using traditional Rajasthani folk motifs and Bandhani-inspired patterns, this tray is a true celebration of Rajasthan’s rich cultural heritage.
